sm_count_provenance: NVIDIA RTX Blackwell GPU Architecture v1.1, Table 1/Table 3; validate against the live CUDA device query.

griddim_penalty_alpha.reason: No RTX 5090 grid-density sweep has been captured.

l2_geometry.reason: Vendor documentation supplies a 96 MiB RTX 5090 L2 capacity, but slice mapping, sector policy, and replacement behavior are not yet measured.

l2_vendor_summary.provenance: NVIDIA RTX Blackwell GPU Architecture v1.1, Table 1/Table 3; capacity is vendor information, not a replay-ready geometry card.

l1_geometry.reason: The CC 12.0 unified L1/texture/shared geometry and cache carveout behavior have not been measured on this RTX 5090.

nvml_reference_operating_point.reason: Clock sweep samples are collection settings, not a calibrated simulator cycle/wall-time crosswalk.

duration_crosswalk.reason: No independent simulator-cycle to wall-clock crosswalk exists for this SKU.

dram_bandwidth.reason: 1792 GB/s is a vendor peak specification, not an achieved locked-protocol service rate; no RTX 5090 clock/memory sweep is retained yet.

smsp.reason: SMSP count and issue-port topology are not inferred from the 170-SM product count.

occupancy_provenance: Retained RTX 5090 cudaDevAttrMaxBlocksPerMultiprocessor=24 in m4/launch_probe.jsonl; CUDA tuning-guide statement of 32 conflicts with this device attribute. Do not reinterpret the direct device attribute as a kernel-specific occupancy result.

runtime_limits.provenance: Retained live CUDA device attributes in /dev/shm/sm120_rtx_5090_work/m4/launch_probe.jsonl (device row); identifier limits and shared-memory capacities retained. max_blocks_per_sm=24 is a device attribute, not only the M8 occupancy result.

dep_barriers.reason: Dependency-barrier resource count has not been measured on SM120.

barrier_latencies.reason: Barrier issue/read/write latencies have not been measured on SM120.

dual_issue.reason: Dual-issue behavior is not assumed from the Blackwell generation label.

vendor_spec.provenance: NVIDIA RTX Blackwell GPU Architecture v1.1, Table 1/Table 3; public CUDA 13.2 CC12.0 tuning ceiling; live nvidia-smi reports a 600 W board limit; vendor/runtime facts only.

research_gaps: sm120 RTX 5090 L1/L2 geometry and cache policy
sm120 RTX 5090 instruction issue and tensor-pipeline intervals
sm120 RTX 5090 clock and wall-time crosswalk
notes: This card is intentionally separate from sm_120-laptop; a CC 12.0 token alone must not select between SKUs.
The card is vendor-informed and not a claim that the simulator already supports SM120 replay.
The 120a/120f build tokens are compile-family vocabulary; each feature requires a live compile and run probe.
